resources.string: This permission is turned off for the app. Open Settings → Permissions to turn it back on.
The app needs the camera to photograph the outlet, displays and documents for the visit.
The app needs your location to confirm you are at the right outlet when you check in and clock in.
The app needs the microphone to record the customer\'s feedback.
The app needs notifications to tell you about approvals and assigned plans, and to keep location tracking running during working hours.
